stats.text:
You learn the *{ref:spell/find-familiar}* spell and can cast it as a {ref:glossary/magic} action without expending a spell slot.

When you cast the spell, you choose one of the normal forms for your familiar or one of the following special forms: **{ref:creature/imp}**, **{ref:creature/pseudodragon}**, **{ref:creature/quasit}**, **{ref:creature/skeleton}**, **{ref:creature/sphinx-of-wonder}**, **{ref:creature/sprite}**, or **{ref:creature/venomous-snake}** (see "Monsters" for the familiar's stat block).

Additionally, when you take the {ref:glossary/attack} action, you can forgo one of your own attacks to allow your familiar to make one attack of its own with its {ref:glossary/reaction}.
